extracted.intended_audience: inventors, applicants, patent attorneys/agents and national/regional IP offices using the PCT system
extracted.subtask_description: A navigational and reference guide to the PCT (Patent Cooperation Treaty) system covering the international and national phases, per‑Contracting‑State Annexes (office functions), forms and practical eGuide usage for applicants and practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: The PCT Applicant’s Guide "is updated virtually every week with information received from PCT Contracting States and Offices."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users are invited to sign up for 'PCT Guide Updates' and email updates to receive weekly revisions and additions; the guide is a living document reflecting incoming information from Offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to the International Phase
rubrics_metrics.description: A principal part of the Guide titled 'Introduction to the International Phase' (available as PDF).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the principal reference for procedures and guidance applicable during the international phase of a PCT application; available in multiple languages (see 'Language availability').

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to the National Phase
rubrics_metrics.description: A principal part of the Guide titled 'Introduction to the National Phase' (available as PDF).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides guidance on entering national/regional phases after the international phase; available in multiple languages (see 'Language availability').

rubrics_metrics.name: Per‑Contracting‑State Annexes (office functions)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Guide "contains ... the various Annexes concerning all Contracting States and Offices divided according to the functions of the Offices. You may navigate through the table below and click the respective icon 'X' to access information about a particular State or Office acting in a specific capacity."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each Contracting State/Organization has an Annex/profile that indicates which functions the Office performs (see table columns) and provides state‑specific procedural details and contact links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office function indicators (table columns)
rubrics_metrics.description: The table shows per country/organization whether the Office performs: International Phase, National Phase, General Information, Receiving Offices, International Searching Authorities (ISA), ISA (Supplementary Search), International Preliminary Examining Authorities (IPEA), Deposits of Biological Material, National Chapter and specific Annexes (Annex B, Annex C, Annex D, Annex SISA, Annex E, Annex L, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An 'X' in the table marks that the State/Office acts in that capacity; users rely on these indicators to know which procedural services (RO, ISA, IPEA, deposit handling) are available for a given State.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms (other useful information)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides links and references to the PCT forms and other practical documents applicants need for filing and prosecution; users should consult the relevant form links for submission requirements and formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: EQE Candidates — special version of eGuide
rubrics_metrics.description: A special version of the eGuide tailored for 'EQE Candidates'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains targeted content/format for candidates preparing for the European Qualifying Examination; indicates that some guide content has special variants for particular audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical tips (searching and printing in the eGuide)
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical tips: 'Until automatic searching and printing tools are added, you can: search any part or profile of the eGuide using the “Ctrl + F” shortcut, and print by using “Ctrl + P” or the print functionality of your Web browser. All supported browsers will include the ability to “print to PDF”'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides users on immediate, manual ways to search and produce printable/PDF copies of eGuide content; notes that enhanced search/print tools may be added later.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The main Guide parts (Introduction to the International Phase and Introduction to the National Phase) are available as PDF and 'also available in Chinese, French, Japanese, Spanish and Russian.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates multilingual availability of core guide documents; users can access the PDFs in those languages for non‑English reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Navigation by alphabet and country profiles
rubrics_metrics.description: The PCT Contracting States section is arranged alphabetically (A–Z) and each entry links to country/organization profiles with codes (Two‑Letter Code plus Country or Organization).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users can navigate to a specific State/Organization profile by alphabet or two‑letter code to find the Annex and function indicators for that jurisdiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related resources and contact links
rubrics_metrics.description: The page provides related links such as contact (https://www3.wipo.int/contact/en/area.jsp?area=pct), pressroom, terms of use, privacy policy, accessibility, sitemap, newsletters, podcasts and news RSS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These links give operational contacts, legal/policy information, and channels for updates and further support; applicants and practitioners should use the contact and newsroom links for announcements and clarifications.
